description.short: Built using Microsoft 365 Copilot Agent Builder
description.full: Analyzes Git repositories before cloning, downloading, installing, or running them. Reviews source code, agent skills, MCP servers, and related tools for prompt injection, jailbreaks, unsafe execution, data exfiltration, telemetry, supply-chain risks, suspicious dependencies, and external reputation. Provides evidence with file paths, severity, limitations, and a clear safety recommendation.
